candidate_ledger.time_window_catalyst: Middle East oil-flow headlines and any inflation-sensitive reaction around August 12 CPI and August 13 PPI.

A rapid de-escalation or reopening arrangement for the Strait of Hormuz reverses oil and energy-sensitive trades.
Recent commodity and metals strength proves overextended and mean-reverts during the scoring week.
SPY momentum persists after its record close, led by mega-cap technology not represented in the selected portfolio.

portfolio_rationale: The portfolio avoids relying on SPY after a record close and instead combines event-sensitive commodity/safe-haven exposures with defensive and international diversifiers. Selected holdings have base forecasts above the SPY base case and no non-benchmark cluster exceeds the 50% cap.
rationale_summary: One-week alpha is expected to come from unresolved oil-supply risk, precious-metals support, commodity/mining momentum, and selective defensive rotation around CPI, PPI, and retail-sales releases. The main tradeoff is higher idiosyncratic volatility versus the benchmark.
